stem:
A business owner opens a new investment account with a $10,000.00 deposit:

• The investment account earns 2.5% interest, compounded annually.

• The business owner does not plan to make any deposits or withdrawals.

How much interest will the investment account earn at the end of the first and second years?
instruction: Move the correct answer to each box. Not all answers will be used.
response_template:
The account will earn [blank_1] in interest at the end of the first year.

At the end of the second year, the account will have earned a total of [blank_2] in interest.
